prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1004; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear quarter panel and left taillight assembly show crush and fracture patterns that line up with the impact described, with the energy running from the rear corner forward along the bumper cover. Repairs proposed include replacing the taillight, refinishing the quarter panel, and straightening the bumper bracket. The estimated labor time runs slightly above what this damage typically requires, so I have asked the shop to review the hour count line by line. Parts pricing and the invoices submitted to date are consistent, with no duplicate charges. Nothing in the file or the owner's history points to earlier damage on this area of the vehicle.
